scope: Private metadata-only receipt import and expiry recovery; CLI file hygiene, digest/binding checks and output projection.
result: No new concrete accounting CLI defect found within this bounded source and invented-input review.

executedByIndependentReviewer.workingDirectory: isolated temporary review directory with reviewed accounting source links

executedByIndependentReviewer.command: node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --target ES2024 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --allowImportingTsExtensions --verbatimModuleSyntax --erasableSyntaxOnly --skipLibCheck --types node tests/accounting-cli-independent.test.ts

independentControls: An unchanged expired approval permits recording already-incurred costs without changing approval digest, revision or expiry, removing the expiry freeze, or granting another attempt.
After a newer revision increases cumulative USD and CPU, duplicate import of the old receipt returns historical revision and CPU separately from the latest durable charge and evidence digest.
A self-consistent accepted receipt/context naming an absent reservation rejects before journal creation and preserves the existing hold.
Switching to a fresh journal path cannot reset the ledger's applied receipt history or change its known charge.
Using an approval JSON input as the journal path rejects before constructor writes; original file bytes and ledger state are preserved.
sourceReviewChecks: Only import and recover-expired verbs are accepted.
Explicit independently supplied context and parsed-budget digests are checked before constructing the mutable importer.
Existing ledger and reservation are checked before importer initialization; immutable reservation bindings must match.
Private bounded file reads reject workspace paths, symlink ancestors, hardlinks and broad permissions; the helper explicitly does not claim same-UID isolation.
Output omits raw receipts, operation inventory, approval prose, file paths and exception details.
No runtime execution, reserve, approval synchronization, markAttempted or provider function is invoked by the CLI.
limitations: All budgets, receipts, observations and database records were invented test inputs; no provider bill or external identity was authenticated.
The operator must independently authenticate the receipt, context and accepted digests; consistency hashes alone do not establish authenticity.
The fresh-journal refusal can leave an unused private importer file because importer construction binds identity; this is not a read-only command.
Privileged same-UID mutation and restoring both accounting databases from stale backups remain outside file-hygiene guarantees.

The isolated typecheck initially could not resolve the existing zod dependency through source links; linking the already-installed dependency tree fixed the review environment, with no source or dependency changes.
No sealed corpus, repair/provider/executor source or candidate execution was used for this review.
